detailed_descriptions.en: Create and manage your dream egg farm in this complete egg production simulator. Start small with a few chickens and grow into a true rural empire, producing eggs from different species and colors. Acquire chickens, ducks, geese, and turkeys — each with unique needs. Unpack the delivery boxes and place your animals in specific pens designed for each species. Use your trays to collect fresh eggs and sell them at the vending machine. The larger and more diverse your production, the greater your profit and XP! Keep your birds healthy and productive. Regularly refill their food and water containers, choosing feeds of different qualities to improve their well-being and production. When necessary, apply medicines and vaccines to strengthen their immunity and keep your farm perfectly balanced. Buy shelves, furniture, and plants to organize your items and optimize space. Expand your production by renting new pens, but manage your finances carefully — each area brings new expenses. You’ll have to pay water, electricity, and internet bills. Grow strategically and turn your farm into a true egg empire! Start small and grow step by step until you become the region’s top egg producer. Earn XP by completing daily tasks such as collecting eggs, selling trays, and caring for animals. Level up, unlock new licenses, and expand your production. Follow the day-and-night cycle, keep your farm always active, and watch your empire hatch — it all begins with a single egg.

You’ll have to pay water, electricity, and internet bills. Grow strategically and turn your farm into a true egg empire!

Start small and grow step by step until you become the region’s top egg producer. Earn XP by completing daily tasks such as collecting eggs, selling trays, and caring for animals. Level up, unlock new licenses, and expand your production. Follow the day-and-night cycle, keep your farm always active, and watch your empire hatch — it all begins with a single egg.
